title: Pukers Ruining Dungeon Idol
description: Pukers Ruining Dungeon Idol — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Chuck McBarris

Quest Type: Search and Destroy

Quest Description: Kill 16 Ice Mutant Pukers in the offs of Frump's Misfortune and recover the Literature they are carrying.

Quest Reward: 18750 gold

Return to: Chuck McBarris

Next Quest Given: Shadows Over Dungeon Idol

Repeatable: No

Tip: A routine mob killing quest. Find them, kill them, collect.

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 16 pieces of literature from Frost Mutant Pukers in Deathtroit, Cleaveland, or H.E.L.L.A. and return them to Chuck McBarris in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort

Offer:

We have a large group of Frost Mutant Puker protesters forming inside the Dungeon Idol facilities. They have been handing out leaflets with propaganda claiming Dungeon Runner cruelty. They believe having Dungeon Runners run dungeons for entertainment purposes only serves as punishment and deprivation. They don't believe that it's natural for Dungeon Runners to be inclined to violent physical acts for pleasure. They believe Dungeon Runners are performing because they're afraid not to.

Rubbish is what I say. We all know Dungeon Runners such as yourself volunteer for the 'mad drops' and 'phat loot' in recognition for your achievements!

We can't continue to let these Frost Mutant Pukers spew lies and litter our grounds with their propaganda. It's bad for business, it's causing us to lose contestants, and kill the morale of the creatures entered into the contest. All in all, it's bad for our ratings and shareholders. We need you to rid the Frump's Misfortune of this 'literature'. Kill the Frost Mutant Pukers and get their propaganda.

Frost Mutant Pukers can be found hanging out with all the other creatures attempting to convince them of their 'truths'. They are congregating in Frump's Misfortune in the areas known as Deathtroit, Cleaveland, and in H.E.L.L.A. Once you picked up all the 'litter'ature, bring it back to your pal Chuck McBarris here in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Turn-in:

Wow! I definitely enjoy having someone from the outside who is able to take care of our problems without having to worry about red tape or lawsuits.

FYI, the execs think of you as a team player with all this synergy. I got a memo that they want for us to communicate ASAP in order to touch base. Whenever you are ready to step up to the plate, drop on by so we can move forward with some action items.

Objectives:

  • Literature ×16

Level range: 25–45
